SELECT i_item_id, 
       AVG(ss_quantity) AS agg1, 
       AVG(ss_list_price) AS agg2, 
       AVG(ss_coupon_amt) AS agg3, 
       AVG(ss_sales_price) AS agg4 
FROM store_sales 
JOIN customer_demographics ON store_sales.ss_cdemo_sk = customer_demographics.cd_demo_sk 
JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk 
JOIN item ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk 
JOIN (
    SELECT p_promo_sk
    FROM promotion
    WHERE p_channel_email = 'N' OR p_channel_event = 'N'
) AS filtered_promotion ON store_sales.ss_promo_sk = filtered_promotion.p_promo_sk 
WHERE customer_demographics.cd_gender = 'F' 
  AND customer_demographics.cd_marital_status = 'W' 
  AND customer_demographics.cd_education_status = 'College' 
  AND date_dim.d_year = 2001 
GROUP BY i_item_id 
ORDER BY i_item_id 
LIMIT 100
